sso_deploy_and_verify.s:
Push both repos (Cloudflare Workers Builds deploy on git push), then verify the full SSO loop on the live sites and document the apexlinks.org hard limit.

Backstory: e4 and beee now share one session cookie (Domain=.beeeproject.com), one SECRET, one token format, one Qdrant collection 'i', and one email-keyed identity. The remaining claim — that the same login should work on apexlinks.org and *.apexlinks.org — is IMPOSSIBLE without touching apexlinks code: a cookie set for '.beeeproject.com' is never sent to '.apexlinks.org' (browsers enforce registrable-domain scoping; a server can only set a cookie whose Domain is a suffix of its own host), and the standard SSO alternative is a redirect/token-exchange dance that requires receiving-side code on apexlinks apps. All *.apexlinks.org apps are separate Cloudflare Workers (e.g. ver.apexlinks.org) on a different zone. So nothing on the beeeproject side can make an e4/beee login 'valid' there. Document this in the e4 AGENTS.md under a short 'SSO' note and in beee's docs/about.md only if a structural fact changes (it does not — skip about.md).

STEP 1 — confirm both pushes from the prior steps are live: e4 at https://e4.beeeproject.com/login, beee at https://beeeproject.com/login. Check the Set-Cookie header on a beee login attempt carries Domain=.beeeproject.com:
  curl -sI 'https://beeeproject.com/login' | head -5  (page 200; the domain cookie appears on POST /api/auth/login)
  curl -s -c /tmp/opencode/beee.jar -X POST 'https://beeeproject.com/api/auth/login' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"i@i.com","password":"wrong"}' -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n'   (401, no cookie)

STEP 2 — browser verification (use the agent-browser skill / ~/.agents/skills/agent-browser/SKILL.md):
(a) Sign up a fresh user on beeeproject.com via email+password (or reuse a known account), land logged-in, read the 'session' cookie and assert Domain=.beeeproject.com;
(b) navigate to https://e4.beeeproject.com/i — must show the SAME signed-in user with NO login prompt (this proves the beee->e4 leg, and that SECRETs match in prod — if it redirects to login, the prod SECRET differs and the fix is to make e4's prod SECRET equal beee's);
(c) repeat the reverse leg: log into e4 (Google or the email form) and open https://beeeproject.com/dashboard — must be signed in;
(d) verify a session on the OTHER app resolves the same account: on beee dashboard the 'e4 Linked' badge/profile shows the e4-joined date and balance, and on e4 the account page shows the beee user.

STEP 3 — edge check: confirm apexlinks.org and one subdomain (e.g. https://ver.apexlinks.org, https://ed.apexlinks.org) still load normally and are unaffected (they were never touched). Record in the e4 AGENTS.md: 'SSO: e4 & beee share one login (Domain=.beeeproject.com session cookie, shared SECRET, email-keyed users in Qdrant collection "i"). apexlinks.org and *.apexlinks.org cannot share this login without code changes on those apps (different registrable domain).'

STEP 4 — full gates one last time in both repos (`pnpm test` && `pnpm check` in /home/ed/i/e4 and /home/ed/i/beee), commit any AGENTS.md edit, push.
